name: Footballer Strength 2x
description: In-season strength & power around team training: heavy lower body, sprint work, hamstring and groin protection (Nordics, Copenhagen).

days.name: Lower power
days.notes: Not the day before a match.

name: Speed & Agility
description: Field sessions for acceleration, max velocity and change of direction. Quality over quantity - full rest between reps.

exercises.note: 20 m build-up, then 30 m at max speed

name: FIFA 11+ Injury Prevention
description: The FIFA 11+ warm-up before training (about 20 min): running drills, core, Nordics, balance, squats and jumps. Teams doing it at least twice a week had about a third fewer injuries.

sources.title: Soligard et al. 2008, BMJ - cluster RCT, 1892 players

days.name: 11+ warm-up
days.notes: Before training. Level 1 in weeks 1-4, level 2 in weeks 5-8, level 3 from week 9 - only move up when the current level is easy.

exercises.note: Part 1: jog, hip out/in, partner circles, shoulder contact, forward/backward sprints - 2 lengths each

weekSteps.note: Level 3: one leg lifted and held
Each side - level 2: raise and lower the hip
Each side - level 3: with leg lift

exercises.note: Each leg - level 1: hold the ball

weekSteps.note: Each leg - level 2: throw the ball with a partner
Each leg - level 3: partner tests your balance

exercises.note: Level 1: squat with toe raise (30 s)
Part 3: across the pitch at 75-80 % of max pace, jog back

name: Hamstring & Groin Shield
description: The two best-studied prevention exercises for footballers: the Nordic hamstring protocol (about half of hamstring strains prevented) and the Copenhagen adductor programme (41 % fewer groin problems). 10 weeks, then once a week.

sources.title: van der Horst et al. 2015, Am J Sports Med - Nordic hamstring RCT
Harøy et al. 2019, Br J Sports Med - Copenhagen adductor RCT

days.name: Prevention
days.notes: Week 1: 1 session, week 2: 2, weeks 3-10: 3 per week. Afterwards keep 1 session per week. Fits after team training.

exercises.note: Partner holds the heels, fall as slowly as possible
Per side - groin pain above 3/10: short lever (knee on the bench)

name: Aerobic Intervals 4x4
description: 4 × 4 minutes at 90-95 % of max heart rate with 3 minutes of jogging. In the original study players improved VO2max by 11 % and covered 20 % more distance per match.

sources.title: Helgerud et al. 2001, Med Sci Sports Exerc - elite junior footballers

days.name: 4x4 intervals
days.notes: Hard but steady: you can only say a few words. Uphill or dribbling with the ball also works.

exercises.note: 90-95 % of max heart rate, 3 min jog between

name: Repeated Sprint Ability
description: Short shuttle sprints with short rests - trains the ability to sprint again and again in the second half. 6 weeks, 1-2 sessions per week.

sources.title: Bishop, Girard & Mendez-Villanueva 2011, Sports Med - training recommendations

days.name: RSA session
days.notes: Not the day before a match. Stop the block when sprint times drop clearly.

exercises.note: 20 m + 20 m - 3 blocks of 6, 4 min between blocks

weekSteps.note: 20 m + 20 m - 3 blocks of 7, 4 min between blocks
20 m + 20 m - 4 blocks of 6, 4 min between blocks

name: Plyometric Power
description: Jump training for higher jumps, faster sprints and sharper cuts. Two sessions per week for 6 weeks, from about 60 to 100 ground contacts.

sources.title: Meta-analysis 2025 - plyometric training in adolescent soccer players

days.name: Vertical & horizontal
days.notes: Every jump at full effort, land quietly. Stop when the jumps get slower.

days.name: Reactive & sprint
days.notes: Short ground contacts - like the floor is hot.

exercises.note: Pogo jumps without a rope also work
From a 30 cm box, jump up right after landing

name: Full Body Beginner
description: Two full-body workouts alternated three times a week. Learn the main lifts and build a base.

name: Machine Full Body
description: Full-body strength on machines and cables - easy to learn, safe to push close to failure. Two workouts alternated, three times a week, 2-3 sets of 10-12 reps as recommended for beginners.

sources.title: ACSM position stand 2009 - progression models in resistance training

days.name: Machines A
days.notes: Set the seat so the joint lines up with the machine's pivot. Add weight once you reach 12 reps in all sets.

days.name: Machines B
days.notes: Same rules: controlled reps, 2 reps in reserve on the last set.

name: 5x5 Linear Progression
description: The classic beginner strength programme: two workouts, three times a week, 5 sets of 5 on the big lifts and a little more weight every session.

days.name: Workout A
days.notes: Start light (about 50 % of your 5-rep max). Failed the same weight 3 times? Take 10 % off and build up again.

name: GZCLP
description: Beginner linear progression in three tiers: heavy T1 (5 × 3), moderate T2 (3 × 10) and light T3 (3 × 15+). Four workouts rotate, 3-4 sessions per week.

exercises.note: T1 - last set as many reps as possible
T3 - last set as many reps as possible, add weight at 25
T1 - last set as many reps as possible
T3 - last set as many reps as possible, add weight at 25
T1 - last set as many reps as possible
T3 - last set as many reps as possible, add weight at 25
T1 - last set as many reps as possible
T3 - last set as many reps as possible, add weight at 25

name: 5/3/1 Boring But Big
description: Jim Wendler's 4-week waves on the main lift (5s, 3s, 5/3/1, deload) plus 5 × 10 volume on the opposite lift. Weights are calculated from your estimated 1RM.

sources.title: 5/3/1 Boring But Big by Jim Wendler

name: PHUL
description: Power Hypertrophy Upper Lower: two heavy days (3-5 reps) and two volume days (8-12 reps) per week - strength and muscle together.

name: Upper / Lower 4x
description: Classic 4-day split for muscle and strength with two upper and two lower days per week.

name: Push / Pull / Legs
description: Three focused days per week. Run it once (3 days) or twice (6 days) per week.

name: Bodyweight Routine
description: Full-body strength without a gym, after the Recommended Routine of r/bodyweightfitness: three pairs (pull/legs, push/hinge, row/push) and a core triplet.

days.name: Full body
days.notes: Do each pair back to back, then rest 90 s. At 8 clean reps move to a harder variation.

exercises.note: Core triplet - per side, with a band
